name: hypergrid
description: A high-performance, interactive data grid web component inspired by spreadsheet applications like Excel. It's developed with Lit for the web component wrapper, Canvas for efficient visual rendering, and Rust compiled to WebAssembly for optimizing complex calculations and data manipulations.

scripts.build:prod: bun run build:lit:prod && bun run build:wasm
scripts.start: bun run build && bun --hot run server
